Flat two-dimensional cartoon. Exactly two anthropomorphic animal characters.
Cast: A is ÓS, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant; B is MICO, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant.
Only props: two same red-yellow wood maracas and one red barrel drum with two feet, all on a plain blue mat. P1 bear kneels with both empty hands on his own knees, two maracas on mat nearby; monkey seats behind drum raising own empty hand. P2 both grip one maraca together during handover, second maraca in bear's other paw; monkey's free hand on drum. No stylized marks or small curved arrows around the maraca. P3 one maraca on mat (set aside by monkey), bear holds the other, and monkey's open palm visibly touches drumhead. P4 each smiles holding one maraca at shoulder height, lifted by natural grip. Their two feet or body positions are visible all the time.
attempts.review: Es mantenen dues maraques i un tambor. L’os les reparteix, el mico deixa la seva a l’estora i toca el tambor abans que cadascú torni a tenir una maraca.
